title: Old Man Cottrell at the Lyric
summary: Watkins saw Old Man Cottrell weekly playing with Kimball's vaudeville band at the Lyric Theatre.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: No. Did you ever hear a few of the other drummers I'll ask you about, like Old Man Cottrell, we were talking about his stuff earlier?

Well, yeah, yeah, I heard Old Man Cottrell, I see him every week at the Old Lyric Theatre, because he was playing out there with the, not the, not the, but the, Kimball, a trumpet player. Mm-hmm. Well, he used to play out there with them when they was having vaudeville out there. At the Lyric. At the Old Lyric Theatre, yeah. And, uh, what, Black Benny?
